notes.title: End of Everything Update Coming Soon! - v0.1.2
notes.notes:
Hey Survivors!

We’re excited to bring you the upcoming patch for End of Everything! This update addresses several key issues and introduces new features to enhance your survival experience.

Take a look at what we have in store for v0.1.2, coming soon!

Unity Engine v6 Transition We’re thrilled to announce that our project will transition to Unity’s new Engine v6! This upgrade will bring significant enhancements, including:


 Improved Performance: Experience smoother gameplay with optimized rendering and resource management.
 Enhanced Visuals: Take advantage of advanced graphics capabilities, allowing for more realistic environments and character models.
 Better Physics: Enjoy improved physics interactions, making the game world feel more dynamic and responsive.
 New Features: Access the latest tools and functionalities available in Unity v6, allowing us to implement innovative gameplay mechanics and visual effects.


New Features:


 Graphics Settings Fix: Settings will now save correctly, ensuring your preferences are applied.
 Alien Invasion UFOs: Look up at night to see UFOs searching for survivors! You may encounter a rare alien with out-of-this-world items!
 Permadeath Option: Choose to enable or disable permadeath for not eating or drinking.
 Gameplay Showcase Update: The Steam store page will feature gameplay footage for both single-player and multiplayer modes.
 New Launcher: Easily load into single-player, co-op, or multiplayer game modes, report bugs, and view credits.
 XP Bar and Leveling System: Track your progress with the new XP bar! Leveling up grants boosts to HP, hunger, thirst, stamina, bag space, and carry weight.
 Blueberry Saving: You can now save blueberries even when your health and thirst are at 100%.
 Resource Requirements Update: The needed resources for log buildings are now rope, sticks, and logs. Stone will be coming soon!
 New Props and Buildings: A variety of new props and buildings have been added, with more on the way!
 Map Update: The previous lake map has been replaced with a new design featuring suburban hills and diverse environments!
 Steam SDK Integration: Improved interaction with Steam features.


Multiplayer Game Modes: Features one map with three game modes:

 Slaughter (FFA): Free-for-all combat.
 Team Slaughter (TDM): Team-based deathmatch.
 Capture the Crawler (CTF): A unique capture-the-flag style game.


Gameplay Improvements:


 Armor Adjustments: Higher-tier armor now effectively increases your HP and damage resistance.
 Physical Colliders: Added physical colliders to all trees for improved realism and interaction.
 Increased Resource Nodes: More resource nodes and prefabs have been added for improved gameplay balance, including cloth nodes that can be found on objects like couches and other furniture.



Bug Fixes:


 Building Save Issue: Resolved the problem where buildings were not saved upon loading.
 Collision Fix: Players can no longer walk through buildings, improving immersion.
 Zombie Behavior Adjustments: Fixed issues with zombies being immune to damage in the tutorial and corrected hitboxes, also zombies can no longer chase you through objects.
 Menu Resolution/Settings Fixes: Adjusted settings for displays above 1080p to prevent crashes, also all settings can now be saved correctly.
 Shooting Range Redesign: Enhanced the shooting range for a better learning experience.
 Saveable Objects Progress: Continued improvements on saving objects in the game.
 Crafting Balances: Refined resource requirements for better game balance.


What to Expect in the Future from Version 0.1.3:


 Other Platforms Coming Soon: We’re excited to announce plans for releasing on additional platforms in the future!
 Controller Support: Full controller support will be introduced in the next patch for a better gameplay experience.
 31 New Weapons and Guns: Get ready for an expanded arsenal with 31 new melee and ranged weapons!
 Easter Eggs and Achievements: Discover hidden Easter eggs and unlock achievements to enhance your gameplay experience!
 More Maps for Multiplayer: Expect new maps to enrich your multiplayer experiences!
 Co-op Game Mode for Single Player: A co-op game mode will be added for the open world experience.
 New Game Mode – Outlast: Experience the new Outlast game mode in multiplayer, similar to CoD Zombies!
 Open World Items: Working on adding open world items that can be placed inside buildings.
 Zombie Drop Table: A new zombie drop table will enhance the loot system.
 Zombie Animation and SFX Fixes: Improvements to zombie animations and sound effects for a more immersive experience.


Thank you for standing by us during this Early Access release. We’re excited about the patches ahead, so stay tuned!

🔗 Get End of Everything now on Steam

Kind regards,
Happy Dayz Games

notes.title: Early Access Release - Version 0.1.1 is Live Now!
notes.notes:
Hey Survivors!

We’re thrilled to announce that End of Everything is officially live in Early Access! 🎉 Dive into the post-apocalyptic world and start your journey in version 0.1.1, featuring the single-player open-world survival mode.

For a limited time, you can grab the game at a 20% discount! Explore, scavenge, and survive in this desolate world while facing off against zombies.

This is just the beginning—many updates are planned throughout the Early Access lifecycle, including the highly anticipated Co-Op Zombies mode coming in future updates!

🔗 Get End of Everything now on Steam

We’d love to hear your thoughts—please report bugs and provide feedback on our Steam Discussions Page. Your feedback helps us shape the game’s future!

Thank you for your support, and welcome to the apocalypse!

Kind regards,  
Happy Dayz Games
